steps.en: Clone the repo, add it as a plugin marketplace and install the plugin
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，加为插件市场并安装插件

steps.en: Start the agent in your repo, trust the folder, record its tool catalog once
steps.zh: 在你的仓库启动 agent，信任目录，记录一次工具清单

steps.en: Keep working in that repository as usual, session after session
steps.zh: 照常在这个仓库里一轮轮开会话干活

steps.en: Folds each finished session log into per-repo evidence on disk
steps.zh: 把每个结束的会话日志折进本机的仓库证据

steps.en: Injects confirmed repo facts at session start; denies long-unused tools
steps.zh: 会话开头注入已确认的仓库事实，禁掉长期不用的工具

steps.en: Watches each turn; a judge redirects a stuck loop once, then tells you
steps.zh: 逐轮盯循环，判官认定卡住时先提醒一次，再告诉你

value.en: Later sessions in the same repo stop paying to relearn it, carry fewer tools and loop less
value.zh: 同一仓库的后续会话不再花钱重新摸索、少带工具、少空转
